claim: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon on July 20, 1969.

check.quote: Eagle landed at 20:17:40 UTC on Sunday July 20 ... Armstrong became the first human to walk on the Moon approximately six hours after landing, followed by Aldrin nineteen minutes later.
